item.title: Girls' Sports Day Should Be for Girls | Payton McNabb
item.description: Let's celebrate all the achievements that women have made in the sports arena since Title IX was passed in 1972.

item.title: Top NHL Prospect Gavin McKenna Charged With Assault Stemming From Incident Hours After Outdoor Game
item.description: Penn State hockey freshman Gavin McKenna, a projected 2026 NHL Draft No. 1 pick, is facing felony aggravated assault charges following an alleged incident in State College.

item.title: Patriots Owner Robert Kraft Highlights Standing Against Hate With 2026 Super Bowl Spot

item.title: US Skating Star Ilia Malinin Rocks Alex Ovechkin’s Yellow Laces At 2026 Olympics
item.description: Alex Ovechkin won’t appear at the 2026 Winter Olympics, but his iconic yellow laces will, as US figure skating star Ilia Malinin wears them while chasing gold in Milan.

item.description: It's a sad day when you come to the realization that one of your oldest friends in the world is no longer on the same wavelength as you are. The passing of time has done something to your relationship.

item.description: Take a deep dive into Gavin Newsom’s Vogue-era "image," GRAMMY-night "ICE out" activism, and a Super Bowl flashpoint over the NFL bringing in Bad Bunny.

item.title: Are The Dodgers Bad For Baseball? Their Biggest Rival Has An Answer
item.description: Giants CEO Larry Baer defends Los Angeles Dodgers' aggressive spending strategy, saying having a dominant team "isn't necessarily a bad thing for the sport" during recent interview.

item.title: Tony Dungy Pushes Back On Media Race Narrative Around NFL Coaching Hires
item.description: Tony Dungy discusses the lack of Black head coaching hires in the NFL, telling Dan Dakich the issue is more complex than race and rooted in how teams evaluate candidates.

item.title: Lakers Player Goes Tough Guy On Mascot, Gets Suspended
item.description: Lakers center Jaxson Hayes will sit out Thursday after the NBA suspended him one game without pay for shoving the Washington Wizards’ mascot during pregame introductions last Friday.

item.title: New Dumbledore In 'Harry Potter' TV Series Calls JK Rowling's Views 'Inexplicable'
item.description: John Lithgow calls J.K. Rowling's transgender views "ironic and inexplicable" while defending his role as Dumbledore in HBO's Harry Potter series.
